## Validation

- [ ] Relevant targeted tests pass.
- [ ] Smoke pipeline passes, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and repository tree remain consistent.
- [ ] No data, credentials, checkpoints, raw runs, or other large artifacts are committed.
